js: 'Chat voice §8.5, the 2026-10-04 ruling: a voice turn whose model reasons although the turn asked for reasoning off shows the reasoning in the thread (the collapsed thinking block, live and after the read-back), never speaks or captions it, and says so once on the panel status line; the timing readout names the reasoning time. Against an in-page bound session (scripts/realtime-mock.js, which sends reasoning frames as the server does) and the fake microphone of the panel drive; no model runs. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-voice-reasoning.json --mute-audio --base <dev gateway> --token-file <its token> (the clips from scripts/drive/make-voice-fixtures.py in target/chat-voice/fixtures/voice-de.js).'

label: a temporary chat whose voice button is enabled

js: window.lmgwRealtimeMock.install({thread: Number(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('t')), warmMs: 200, thinkMs: 400, audioMs: 2400, question: 'Wie spät ist es?', reply: 'Es ist halb neun. Bis gleich.', reasoning: 'Der Nutzer fragt nach der Uhrzeit. Ich antworte knapp und freundlich.', reasoningNote: 'nano-mock cannot switch reasoning off; it reasons at its lowest level (minimal)'})

label: live: the reply bubble shows the reasoning in its thinking block
the thinking block is collapsed, as in a text turn

until: (document.querySelector('[data-rt-status] [data-note=reasoning]')?.textContent || '').includes('nano-mock cannot switch reasoning off; it reasons at its lowest level (minimal)')
label: the panel's status line says the model reasoned although off was asked

expect: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('[data-rt-panel]'); const spoken = p.dataset.voiceSpoken || ''; return /halb neun/.test(spoken) && !/Uhrzeit|freundlich/.test(spoken); })()
label: the spoken words are the reply's, none of the reasoning
the reply's text holds no reasoning
the timing readout names the reasoning time

until: (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.msg-assistant')].pop(); const d = a?.querySelector('details.reasoning'); return !!d && /Uhrzeit/.test(d.textContent) && /halb neun/.test(a.querySelector('.md').textContent); })()
label: after the read-back the reply still shows its reasoning block and its text
